backend/main.mo: Marketplace canister defining items, listings, transactions, access control, and CRUD operations for creating and managing listings.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented PWA-related features, affected files, components, and linked requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries describing the role of each frontend file and component in the application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining warm amber/orange OKLCH color tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point configuring PWA metadata, manifest, icons, and service worker registration.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, colors, start URL, icons, and shortcuts for installability.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page styled with branding for when the app has no network connection.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing install caching, cache cleanup, and network-first fetch handling with offline fallback.
frontend/PWA_PLAY_STORE_TWA.md: Documentation explaining how to publish the PWA to Google Play via a Trusted Web Activity wrapper.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the root layout and defines all main routes for browsing, viewing, creating, and managing listings using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Wraps protected content and shows a login prompt when the user is not authenticated.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Renders a login/logout button and manages authentication flow with fallback handling for edge cases.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the main page structure with a header, footer, and content area.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Displays a footer with branding, the current year, and a link attribution.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Renders the top navigation bar with branding, navigation links, login, and PWA install actions.
frontend/src/components/listings/DeleteL: Provides a confirmation dialog for deleting a listing and handles the delete mutation.
frontend/src/components/listings/EditLis: Shows a dialog containing a pre-filled listing form and triggers the update listing mutation.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Displays a listing preview card with status, title, and price, linking to the detail page.
Handles listing creation/editing form input, validation, and formatting before submission.
frontend/src/components/purchase/Purchas: Controls purchase availability states and shows a confirmation dialog to buy a listing.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallPwaBu: Renders an install button for the PWA, handling the beforeinstallprompt event and showing manual install instructions when needed.
frontend/src/components/states/QueryStat: Provides loading, error, and empty-state UI wrappers for query-driven components.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Exposes authentication state and identity helpers derived from Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an authentication context using Dfinity AuthClient, exposing identity, login, logout, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useListingMutations.t: Defines React Query mutations for creating, updating, deleting, and purchasing listings, invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides query hooks to fetch listings and listing details based on actor availability and status.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining theme tokens, dark mode variables, and base typography styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React, wrapping the app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Displays all listings with a search filter and uses QueryState to handle loading, errors, and empty results.
frontend/src/pages/CreateListingPage.tsx: Protected page for creating new listings using a form and create-listing mutation with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Displays a detailed view of a single listing with price, seller info, status, and purchase option using query-based loading.
frontend/src/pages/MyListingsPage.tsx: Shows the authenticated user's listings with status, price, and controls to edit or delete each entry.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme colors, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: JSON metadata describing project state, features, requirements, and expected assets for the marketplace app.
